title.zh: Moving Bitcoin’s Post-Quantum Readiness Forward - Coinbase

current_state.zh: Coinbase 正在开发后量子托管保障，并探索针对非 MPC 友好签名方案的 HSM 备用架构。

updates.title_zh: Inside Coinbase’s $250 Billion Playbook for Post-Quantum Bitcoin Custody
updates.title_en: Inside Coinbase’s $250 Billion Playbook for Post-Quantum Bitcoin Custody
updates.what_changed_zh: Coinbase 首席密码学家 Yehuda Lindell 披露了后量子托管保障的更多细节，包括探索结合后量子阈值解密与可编程 HSM 的备用架构，以应对部分后量子签名方案可能不兼容 MPC 的问题。
updates.what_changed_en: Coinbase's head of cryptography Yehuda Lindell disclosed more details on post-quantum custody safeguards, including exploring a fallback architecture combining post-quantum threshold decryption with programmable HSMs to address potential non-MPC-friendly post-quantum signature schemes.
